name: CASE STUDIES
gates: EVIDENCE GATE - Every published story is supported by clear sources, approved context, and evidence within its stated scope.
meta_description: Customer stories share the context, evidence, and lessons behind work with LAMID ONE.
title: Customer stories, grounded in evidence.
description: A useful customer story makes the context, work, evidence, and lessons clear.

paragraphs.text: A useful customer story makes the context, work, evidence, and lessons clear. That is the standard for stories shared here.
Each story will explain the context, the work completed, the evidence behind the outcome, and where the findings apply.
Examples elsewhere on this site show the kinds of work LAMID ONE is designed to support. Customer stories focus on documented outcomes and lessons.
Each published story will identify the customer's context, the work completed, the evidence collected, and any limits on the findings.
